study: SEWA AI public-data feasibility study (ICH vs no-ICH on non-contrast head CT). Step 1 of the validation prompt: licence verification only. NOT CLINICAL EVIDENCE.
stop_reason: Prompt ground-rule 2: every candidate dataset is non-commercial and two require credentials. The prompt requires stopping and asking before any download under these conditions.

datasets.name: RSNA 2019 Brain CT Hemorrhage Detection Challenge
datasets.licence: Non-commercial licence (RSNA terms of use). NOT a standard SPDX licence.
datasets.licence_excerpt: You may access and use these de-identified imaging datasets and annotations ('the data') for non-commercial purposes only, including academic research and education, as long as you agree to abide by the following provisions: Not to make any attempt to identify or contact any individual(s) who may be the subjects of the data. If you share or re-distribute the data in any form, include a citation ... Flanders AF, et al. Radiology: Artificial Intelligence 2020;2:3.
restrictions: NON-COMMERCIAL ONLY. Company use without permission is out of scope; protocol suggests asking RSNA or running via a university partner.
Kaggle access requires account + competition-rules acceptance + API token.
AWS bucket available but is the same licensed data.
datasets.proposed_subset: Patient-level subset of a few thousand studies (per prompt rule 5) IF licence approved and disk permits

datasets.name: CQ500 (Qure.ai)
datasets.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (per Qure.ai official blog and legal pages)
datasets.licence_excerpt: We make this dataset and the radiologists' reads public under CC-BY-NC-SA license. Other researchers can use this dataset to benchmark their algorithms. (Qure.ai blog; see also qER Lancet paper Chilamkurthy et al.)
restrictions: SHARE-ALIKE (SA): derivative outputs must carry the same licence.
Study-level ground truth = majority of the three radiologists' reads (documented choice).
Known invalid/corrupt series: CQ500CT19, CQ500CT22, CQ500CT25, CQ500CT52, CQ500CT120 (corrupt zip) - see MD.ai notes.
Use official source only; several unofficial mirrors exist (Kaggle 'Qure.ai HeadCT', MD.ai) - not to be used per prompt.

datasets.name: BHX bounding boxes for CQ500 (PhysioNet)
datasets.licence: PhysioNet (open access; check current terms at download time)
restrictions: Use only to test attribution overlap, not to tune.

datasets.name: Hemorica (372 head CT exams)
datasets.official_url: To verify at download step (not yet read official page)
restrictions: Confirm licence permits company use before use.

blocking_decisions_needed: 1. RSNA licence: may we use the non-commercial RSNA data for this company-internal feasibility study, via a university partner, or with RSNA's explicit permission?
2. CQ500 CC BY-NC-SA: acceptable for the study (NC) and are outputs acceptable under SA?
3. Kaggle credentials: does the user have a Kaggle account + API token, or should we pull the RSNA AWS bucket?
4. Disk: only ~33 GiB free now. A subset (few GB-10s GB) is feasible; full RSNA (459 GB) is not on this machine.
5. Compute: does this machine have a GPU? (Prompt recommends one; otherwise CPU training is very slow.)
